findings: Footer reads "© Crush Pizza", another business's name.
Every Order Now button opens the same location picker; the Hudson and Derry ordering pages are never linked directly.
Join Our Team opens a "Coming Soon" page that still contains Wix sample text; there is no way to apply.
The homepage has no address, hours, phone number or description; the logo and one photo are the only content.
The menu page is text only, although 70+ of the shop's own food photos already exist in its online ordering menu.
questions: Boss Hog Sicilian is listed twice on the current menu ($22.00 and $27.00) and at $24.99 in online ordering. Which price is right?

Several menu prices differ from online ordering (Hudson): Gluten Friendly 12" $14.49 vs $12.49; Pesto Blast $14.95 vs $12.99; Steak Tip Salad $16.99 vs $15.99; Crispy Ravioli $7.49 vs $8.49; Beach Pizza $18.99 vs $20.99; Supreme and Chicken Pesto Sicilian $22.00 vs $24.00; Chicken Parm Sicilian $29.89 vs $22.99; several catering pans. Should the website show the online-ordering prices?
Online ordering lists the Derry shop as 9 Crystal Ave, but its web address says 15-crystal-ave. Confirm 9 Crystal Ave.
Where should job applications go (an email address for a manager)?
Do both shops deliver, and is there a delivery area or minimum to show?
Can we have the original photo files from your Toast menu and the Sicilian tray photo for the new site?
